d: Chhath mahaparv par bihar ke Saharsa sthit prasiddh Kandaha Surya Mandir men shraddhaluon ki bhari bhir umarti hai. aastha aur dharmik manyataon se jure is prachin sury mandir ki apni khas pahchan hai. chhath ke mauke par yahan bhakt sury dev ki puja-archana karne pahunchte hain. janie kandaha sury mandir ki dharmik mahima aur isse juri manyataen.
